# DOCUI
My UI for World of Warcraft. Work as of pre-patch launch

## Features
- Layouts for DPS/Tank (Healer WIP)
- Optimised for 1440p 
- Layouts and setups for Blizzard Cooldown Manager 


## Addons
- Unhalted UnitFrames
- Better Cooldown Manager (From Unhalted)
- Unhalted Better Cooldown Manager
- Platynator

  Please note was confirmed to me today BCDM does not have Masque support, it was a happy co-incidence it was working for me but very unstable. So I recommend not using Masque for now if using BCDM.
